_note: A COMMITTED record of the rail's surface token sets, read from agent-infra scripts/admin-merge.sh (the authority for the evaluated-tree surface). The instrument's constants are pinned against THIS file by test_surface_token_sets_match_the_committed_rail_record, which always runs. When the rail is resolvable on the host, test_rail_surface_token_sets_match additionally asserts this record still matches the live rail; that half FAILS (rather than skipping a set) if any declared set is no longer found in the rail, so an unparsable or renamed arm cannot silently retire the pin. A set may only change together with the rail change AND this record, in one commit.
